package windows

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/metastore"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/transport/httprest"
)

const preciseMaxNodes = 64
const preciseMaxBytes = 256 << 10
const preciseMaxEvidenceBytes = 1 << 20

type preciseHistoryPayload struct {
	Request         json.RawMessage
	PreSnapshot     json.RawMessage
	CapturedEvents  json.RawMessage
	StoredReceipt   json.RawMessage
	Acknowledgment  json.RawMessage
	DeliveredEvents json.RawMessage
}

// Only the generated fixture installs this owner. The authority mutex protects
// installation and mutation callbacks; mu protects the source and HTTP join.
type preciseHistory struct {
	mu                                               sync.Mutex
	authority                                        *nativeAuthority
	closed                                           bool
	incarnation                                      metastore.Incarnation
	generation                                       uint64
	streams                                          map[*preciseHistoryStream]bool
	snapshot                                         map[uint64]metastore.Row
	snapshotCount                                    int
	evidence                                         preciseHistoryPayload
	evidenceBytes                                    int
	before, after                                    metastore.Position
	action                                           storage.FileActionID
	reference                                        storage.FileReferenceID
	session                                          uint64
	fingerprint                                      [32]byte
	storedFingerprint                                [32]byte
	request                                          storage.RenameRequest
	begun, ended, finalized, acknowledged, published bool
	events                                           []metastore.Change
	receipt                                          storage.FileActionReceipt
	failure                                          error
	ready                                            chan struct{}
	readyOnce                                        sync.Once
}

type preciseHistoryStream struct {
	upstream    smb.ChangeStream
	owner       *preciseHistory
	ctx         context.Context
	cancel      context.CancelFunc
	generation  uint64
	incarnation metastore.Incarnation
	start       metastore.Position
	mu          sync.Mutex
	closed      bool
	pins        int
	drained     chan struct{}
	closeOnce   sync.Once
	closeErr    error
	registry    map[metastore.Position]*preciseProofRecord
	queued      []metastore.Change
}

type preciseProofRecord struct {
	event       metastore.Change
	root        uint64
	incarnation metastore.Incarnation
	generation  uint64
	refs        int
}

type preciseProof struct {
	stream   *preciseHistoryStream
	record   *preciseProofRecord
	released bool
}

func newPreciseHistory(a *nativeAuthority) *preciseHistory {
	h := &preciseHistory{authority: a, streams: make(map[*preciseHistoryStream]bool), ready: make(chan struct{})}
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	if a.precise != nil {
		panic("duplicate precise history owner")
	}
	a.precise = h
	return h
}

func (h *preciseHistory) wrap(source smb.ChangeSource) smb.ChangeSource {
	subscribe := func(ctx context.Context, open func(context.Context) (smb.ChangeStream, error)) (smb.ChangeStream, error) {
		lifetime, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
		upstream, err := open(lifetime)
		if err != nil {
			cancel()
			return nil, err
		}
		h.mu.Lock()
		if h.closed || len(h.streams) >= 2 || upstream.Incarnation() == "" || h.incarnation != "" && h.incarnation != upstream.Incarnation() {
			h.mu.Unlock()
			cancel()
			return nil, errors.Join(smb.ErrNotifyRescan, upstream.Close())
		}
		h.generation++
		h.incarnation = upstream.Incarnation()
		s := &preciseHistoryStream{upstream: upstream, owner: h, ctx: lifetime, cancel: cancel, generation: h.generation, incarnation: h.incarnation, start: upstream.Position(), registry: make(map[metastore.Position]*preciseProofRecord), drained: make(chan struct{})}
		h.streams[s] = true
		h.mu.Unlock()
		return s, nil
	}
	return smb.ChangeSource{
		Subscribe: func(ctx context.Context) (smb.ChangeStream, error) { return subscribe(ctx, source.Subscribe) },
		Resume: func(ctx context.Context, g metastore.Incarnation, p metastore.Position) (smb.ChangeStream, error) {
			return subscribe(ctx, func(c context.Context) (smb.ChangeStream, error) { return source.Resume(c, g, p) })
		},
		Checkpoint: source.Checkpoint,
	}
}

func preciseRowCost(row metastore.Row) (int, error) {
	metadata, err := storage.EncodeMetadata(row.Node.Metadata)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	cost := 512 + len(row.Name) + len(row.Node.Content) + len(row.Node.LinkTarget) + len(metadata)
	if cost > preciseMaxBytes {
		return 0, syscall.EFBIG
	}
	return cost, nil
}

func preciseRows(rows []metastore.Row) (map[uint64]metastore.Row, error) {
	if len(rows) == 0 || len(rows) > preciseMaxNodes {
		return nil, syscall.EFBIG
	}
	tree := make(map[uint64]metastore.Row, len(rows))
	entries := make(map[storage.EntryID]bool, len(rows))
	siblings := make(map[int64]map[string]bool)
	remaining := preciseMaxBytes
	for _, r := range rows {
		cost, err := preciseRowCost(r)
		if err != nil || cost > remaining {
			return nil, errors.Join(syscall.EFBIG, err)
		}
		remaining -= cost
		if r.Node.ID <= 0 || r.Node.Kind.Check() != nil || r.Node.Size < 0 || r.Node.MetadataRevision == 0 || (r.Node.Kind == storage.NodeDirectory) != (r.Node.DirectoryRevision != 0) {
			return nil, syscall.EIO
		}
		id := uint64(r.Node.ID)
		if _, ok := tree[id]; ok {
			return nil, syscall.EIO
		}
		if r.Parent == 0 {
			if id != 1 || r.EntryID != 0 || len(r.Name) != 0 || r.Node.Kind != storage.NodeDirectory {
				return nil, syscall.EIO
			}
		} else {
			if r.Parent < 0 || r.EntryID == 0 || entries[r.EntryID] {
				return nil, syscall.EIO
			}
			entries[r.EntryID] = true
			key, err := smb.DiagnosticHistoryNameKey(r.Name)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if siblings[r.Parent] == nil {
				siblings[r.Parent] = make(map[string]bool)
			}
			if siblings[r.Parent][key] {
				return nil, syscall.EEXIST
			}
			siblings[r.Parent][key] = true
		}
		r.Name = bytes.Clone(r.Name)
		r.Node = r.Node.Clone()
		tree[id] = r
	}
	if _, ok := tree[1]; !ok {
		return nil, syscall.EIO
	}
	for id, row := range tree {
		location, err := preciseLocation(tree, id)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		image := &metastore.EventImage{Attr: row.Node.Attr(), Location: location, LinkTarget: row.Node.LinkTarget}
		node := row.Node
		check := metastore.Change{Kind: metastore.Modified, Parent: row.Parent, Name: row.Name, Node: &node, Notification: &metastore.Notification{SubjectID: row.Node.ID, SubjectKind: row.Node.Kind, Before: image, After: image}}
		if err := metastore.ValidateNotification(check); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return tree, nil
}

func preciseLocation(tree map[uint64]metastore.Row, id uint64) (storage.EntryLocation, error) {
	location := storage.EntryLocation{RootNodeID: 1, NodeID: id, State: storage.LocationRoot}
	current, ok := tree[id]
	if !ok {
		return location, syscall.ENOENT
	}
	if id == 1 {
		return location, location.Check()
	}
	location.State = storage.LocationLinked
	visited := make(map[uint64]bool)
	for current.Node.ID != 1 {
		currentID := uint64(current.Node.ID)
		if visited[currentID] || len(visited) >= preciseMaxNodes {
			return location, syscall.EIO
		}
		visited[currentID] = true
		parent, ok := tree[uint64(current.Parent)]
		if !ok || parent.Node.Kind != storage.NodeDirectory {
			return location, syscall.EIO
		}
		location.Ancestors = append(location.Ancestors, storage.EntryCondition{ParentID: uint64(current.Parent), DirectoryRevision: parent.Node.DirectoryRevision, EntryID: current.EntryID, NodeID: currentID, Name: bytes.Clone(current.Name)})
		current = parent
	}
	slices.Reverse(location.Ancestors)
	return location, location.Check()
}

func preciseSame(a, b any) bool { return preciseValueSame(reflect.ValueOf(a), reflect.ValueOf(b)) }

func preciseValueSame(a, b reflect.Value) bool {
	if !a.IsValid() || !b.IsValid() {
		return !a.IsValid() && !b.IsValid()
	}
	if a.Type() != b.Type() {
		return false
	}
	if a.Type() == reflect.TypeFor[time.Time]() {
		return a.Interface().(time.Time).Equal(b.Interface().(time.Time))
	}
	switch a.Kind() {
	case reflect.Pointer, reflect.Interface:
		if a.IsNil() || b.IsNil() {
			return a.IsNil() && b.IsNil()
		}
		return preciseValueSame(a.Elem(), b.Elem())
	case reflect.Slice, reflect.Array:
		if a.Len() != b.Len() {
			return false
		}
		for i := 0; i < a.Len(); i++ {
			if !preciseValueSame(a.Index(i), b.Index(i)) {
				return false
			}
		}
		return true
	case reflect.Struct:
		for i := 0; i < a.NumField(); i++ {
			if !preciseValueSame(a.Field(i), b.Field(i)) {
				return false
			}
		}
		return true
	default:
		return reflect.DeepEqual(a.Interface(), b.Interface())
	}
}

func preciseReceiptMatches(returned, stored storage.FileActionReceipt) bool {
	// The HTTP client subtracts transport elapsed time from the history lifetime.
	if returned.HistoryRemaining <= 0 || returned.HistoryRemaining > stored.HistoryRemaining {
		return false
	}
	returned.HistoryRemaining = 0
	stored.HistoryRemaining = 0
	return preciseSame(returned, stored)
}

func preciseImage(tree map[uint64]metastore.Row, image *metastore.EventImage) error {
	if image == nil {
		return syscall.EIO
	}
	row, ok := tree[image.Attr.ID]
	if !ok {
		return syscall.ENOENT
	}
	location, err := preciseLocation(tree, image.Attr.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	expected := metastore.EventImage{Attr: row.Node.Attr(), Location: location, LinkTarget: row.Node.LinkTarget}
	if !preciseSame(expected, *image) {
		return syscall.EIO
	}
	return nil
}

func (h *preciseHistory) Prepare(ctx context.Context, remote *httprest.Storage) (err error) {
	snapshot, err := remote.Snapshot(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { err = errors.Join(err, snapshot.Close()) }()
	rows := make([]metastore.Row, 0, preciseMaxNodes)
	remaining := preciseMaxBytes
	for {
		page, nextErr := snapshot.Next()
		if errors.Is(nextErr, io.EOF) {
			break
		}
		if nextErr != nil {
			return nextErr
		}
		if len(page) > preciseMaxNodes-len(rows) {
			return syscall.EFBIG
		}
		for _, row := range page {
			cost, costErr := preciseRowCost(row)
			if costErr != nil || cost > remaining {
				return errors.Join(syscall.EFBIG, costErr)
			}
			remaining -= cost
			row.Name = bytes.Clone(row.Name)
			row.Node = row.Node.Clone()
			rows = append(rows, row)
		}
	}
	tree, err := preciseRows(rows)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	h.authority.mu.Lock()
	defer h.authority.mu.Unlock()
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.closed || h.snapshot != nil || h.incarnation == "" || string(h.incarnation) != h.authority.identity || snapshot.Position() != h.authority.position() {
		return smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	slices.SortFunc(rows, func(a, b metastore.Row) int {
		if a.Node.ID < b.Node.ID {
			return -1
		}
		if a.Node.ID > b.Node.ID {
			return 1
		}
		return 0
	})
	if err := h.saveEvidenceLocked(&h.evidence.PreSnapshot, rows); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	h.snapshot = tree
	h.snapshotCount = len(tree)
	h.before = snapshot.Position()
	return nil
}

func preciseFingerprint(reference storage.FileReferenceID, request storage.RenameRequest) ([32]byte, error) {
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		Operation storage.Operation
		Input     any
	}{storage.OpFileRename, struct {
		Reference storage.FileReferenceID
		Input     any
	}{reference, request}})
	if err != nil || len(encoded) > preciseMaxBytes {
		return [32]byte{}, errors.Join(syscall.EFBIG, err)
	}
	return sha256.Sum256(encoded), nil
}

func (h *preciseHistory) failLocked(err error) error {
	if err == nil {
		err = smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	h.failure = errors.Join(h.failure, err)
	h.readyOnce.Do(func() { close(h.ready) })
	return h.failure
}

func (h *preciseHistory) Arm(file storage.File, request storage.RenameRequest, action storage.FileActionID) error {
	fingerprint, err := preciseFingerprint(file.Reference(), request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	h.authority.mu.Lock()
	defer h.authority.mu.Unlock()
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.closed || h.snapshot == nil || h.action != "" || request.Check() != nil || request.Source.ExpectedNodeID != file.NodeID() || request.Destination.ExpectedNodeID == 0 || request.Destination.ExpectedNodeID == file.NodeID() {
		return h.failLocked(smb.ErrNotifyRescan)
	}
	var found *nativeFile
	for _, session := range h.authority.sessions {
		if ref := session.files[file.Reference()]; ref != nil {
			if found != nil || ref.node.attr.ID != file.NodeID() || ref.closed || session.closed {
				return h.failLocked(smb.ErrNotifyRescan)
			}
			found = ref
		}
	}
	if found == nil {
		return h.failLocked(syscall.EBADF)
	}
	if _, replayed := found.session.actions[action]; replayed {
		return h.failLocked(smb.ErrNotifyRescan)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		return h.failLocked(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &h.request); err != nil {
		return h.failLocked(err)
	}
	if err := h.saveEvidenceLocked(&h.evidence.Request, h.request); err != nil {
		return h.failLocked(err)
	}
	h.action = action
	h.reference = file.Reference()
	h.session = found.session.id
	h.fingerprint = fingerprint
	return nil
}

func preciseBeginLocked(file *nativeFile, request storage.RenameRequest, action storage.FileActionID, other *nativeNode) {
	h := file.session.authority.precise
	if h == nil {
		return
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.action != action {
		return
	}
	a := file.session.authority
	if h.closed || h.failure != nil || h.begun || h.authority != a || h.incarnation != metastore.Incarnation(a.identity) || h.session != file.session.id || h.reference != file.reference || !preciseSame(request, h.request) || h.before != a.position() || other.attr.ID != request.Destination.ExpectedNodeID || other.entry != request.Destination.ExpectedEntryID || file.node.attr.ID != request.Source.ExpectedNodeID || file.node.entry != request.Source.ExpectedEntryID {
		h.failLocked(smb.ErrNotifyRescan)
		return
	}
	h.begun = true
}

func preciseCopyChange(change metastore.Change) (metastore.Change, error) {
	// Charge before copying the bounded images. The canonical notification encoder
	// separately validates the node/image relationship and bounds its representation.
	encoded, err := metastore.EncodeNotification(change)
	if err != nil {
		return metastore.Change{}, err
	}
	cost := len(encoded) + len(change.Name) + 512
	if change.From != nil {
		cost += len(change.From.Name)
	}
	if change.Node != nil {
		n, err := preciseRowCost(metastore.Row{Node: *change.Node})
		if err != nil {
			return metastore.Change{}, err
		}
		cost += n
	}
	if cost > preciseMaxBytes/2 {
		return metastore.Change{}, syscall.EFBIG
	}
	result := change
	result.Name = bytes.Clone(change.Name)
	if change.From != nil {
		v := *change.From
		v.Name = bytes.Clone(v.Name)
		result.From = &v
	}
	if change.Node != nil {
		v := change.Node.Clone()
		result.Node = &v
	}
	result.Notification, err = metastore.DecodeNotification(result, encoded)
	return result, err
}

func preciseEndLocked(file *nativeFile, action storage.FileActionID) {
	h := file.session.authority.precise
	if h == nil {
		return
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.action != action {
		return
	}
	a := file.session.authority
	if h.failure != nil {
		return
	}
	if h.closed || !h.begun || h.ended || h.session != file.session.id || h.reference != file.reference || a.position() != h.before+2 {
		h.failLocked(smb.ErrNotifyRescan)
		return
	}
	events := make([]metastore.Change, 0, 2)
	for _, event := range a.changes {
		if event.Position <= h.before {
			continue
		}
		if len(events) == 2 || event.Position != h.before+metastore.Position(len(events))+1 {
			h.failLocked(smb.ErrNotifyRescan)
			return
		}
		copy, err := preciseCopyChange(event)
		if err != nil {
			h.failLocked(err)
			return
		}
		events = append(events, copy)
	}
	if len(events) != 2 {
		h.failLocked(smb.ErrNotifyRescan)
		return
	}
	h.after = a.position()
	h.events = events
	h.ended = true
	if err := h.saveEvidenceLocked(&h.evidence.CapturedEvents, events); err != nil {
		h.failLocked(err)
	}
}

func preciseFinalizeLocked(session *nativeSession, action storage.FileActionID) {
	h := session.authority.precise
	if h == nil {
		return
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.action != action {
		return
	}
	stored, ok := session.actions[action]
	if ok && !h.closed && len(h.evidence.StoredReceipt) == 0 {
		h.storedFingerprint = stored.fingerprint
		if err := h.saveEvidenceLocked(&h.evidence.StoredReceipt, stored.result); err != nil {
			h.failLocked(err)
		}
	}
	if h.failure != nil {
		return
	}
	if h.closed || !h.ended || h.finalized || h.session != session.id || !ok || stored.fingerprint != h.fingerprint || stored.err != nil || stored.result.Action != h.action || stored.result.Operation != storage.OpFileRename || stored.result.State != storage.FileActionCompleted || stored.result.Effects != storage.EffectEntryMoved || stored.result.Errno != 0 || stored.result.Observation.Attr.ID != h.request.Source.ExpectedNodeID {
		h.failLocked(smb.ErrNotifyRescan)
		return
	}
	h.receipt = nativeReceiptCopy(stored.result)
	h.finalized = true

}

func preciseInterval(tree map[uint64]metastore.Row, before, after metastore.Position, request storage.RenameRequest, events []metastore.Change) error {
	if len(events) != 2 || after != before+2 || events[0].Position != before+1 || events[1].Position != after || events[0].Kind != metastore.Removed || events[1].Kind != metastore.Renamed {
		return smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	removed, renamed := events[0], events[1]
	for _, event := range events {
		if err := metastore.ValidateNotification(event); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := preciseImage(tree, event.Notification.Before); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if removed.Notification.SubjectID != int64(request.Destination.ExpectedNodeID) || renamed.Notification.SubjectID != int64(request.Source.ExpectedNodeID) || removed.Node != nil || removed.Notification.After != nil || renamed.Node == nil || renamed.Notification.After == nil || renamed.From == nil {
		return smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	if removed.Parent != int64(request.Destination.ParentID) || !bytes.Equal(removed.Name, request.Destination.Name) || renamed.From.Parent != int64(request.Source.ParentID) || !bytes.Equal(renamed.From.Name, request.Source.Name) || renamed.Parent != int64(request.Destination.ParentID) {
		return smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	newName := request.Destination.Name
	if request.NewName != nil {
		newName = request.NewName
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(renamed.Name, newName) || tree[request.Source.ExpectedNodeID].EntryID != request.Source.ExpectedEntryID || tree[request.Destination.ExpectedNodeID].EntryID != request.Destination.ExpectedEntryID {
		return smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	projection := make(map[uint64]metastore.Row, len(tree))
	for id, row := range tree {
		projection[id] = row
	}
	delete(projection, request.Destination.ExpectedNodeID)
	row := projection[request.Source.ExpectedNodeID]
	row.Parent = renamed.Parent
	row.Name = bytes.Clone(renamed.Name)
	row.Node = renamed.Node.Clone()
	projection[request.Source.ExpectedNodeID] = row
	// This fixture's observed atomic rename increments each affected parent once.
	// Both Before images were checked against the one immutable pre-image above.
	for _, parentID := range []uint64{request.Source.ParentID, request.Destination.ParentID} {
		if parentID == request.Destination.ParentID && request.Source.ParentID == request.Destination.ParentID {
			continue
		}
		parent, ok := projection[parentID]
		if !ok {
			return smb.ErrNotifyRescan
		}
		parent.Node.DirectoryRevision++
		projection[parentID] = parent
	}
	if request.Source.ParentID == request.Destination.ParentID {
		parent := projection[request.Source.ParentID]
		parent.Node.DirectoryRevision++
		projection[request.Source.ParentID] = parent
	}
	rows := make([]metastore.Row, 0, len(projection))
	for _, row := range projection {
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	checked, err := preciseRows(rows)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return preciseImage(checked, renamed.Notification.After)
}

func (h *preciseHistory) Acknowledge(receipt storage.FileActionReceipt, barrier *httprest.MutationBarrier, operationErr error) error {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if !h.closed && len(h.evidence.Acknowledgment) == 0 {
		outcome := struct {
			Receipt storage.FileActionReceipt
			Barrier *httprest.MutationBarrier
			Error   string
		}{receipt, barrier, ""}
		if operationErr != nil {
			outcome.Error = operationErr.Error()
		}
		if err := h.saveEvidenceLocked(&h.evidence.Acknowledgment, outcome); err != nil {
			return h.failLocked(err)
		}
	}
	if h.failure != nil {
		return h.failure
	}
	if h.closed || h.acknowledged || !h.finalized || operationErr != nil || barrier == nil || barrier.Incarnation != string(h.incarnation) || barrier.Position != int64(h.after) || !preciseReceiptMatches(receipt, h.receipt) {
		return h.failLocked(errors.Join(smb.ErrNotifyRescan, operationErr))
	}
	if err := preciseInterval(h.snapshot, h.before, h.after, h.request, h.events); err != nil {
		return h.failLocked(err)
	}
	h.acknowledged = true
	h.readyOnce.Do(func() { close(h.ready) })
	return nil
}

func (s *preciseHistoryStream) Incarnation() metastore.Incarnation { return s.incarnation }
func (s *preciseHistoryStream) Position() metastore.Position       { return s.start }

func (s *preciseHistoryStream) Next() (metastore.Change, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	if s.closed {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return metastore.Change{}, syscall.EBADF
	}
	if len(s.queued) > 0 {
		event := s.queued[0]
		s.queued[0] = metastore.Change{}
		s.queued = s.queued[1:]
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return event, nil
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()
	first, err := s.upstream.Next()
	if err != nil {
		return metastore.Change{}, err
	}
	h := s.owner
	h.mu.Lock()
	if h.closed || h.generation != s.generation || h.incarnation != s.incarnation {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		return metastore.Change{}, smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	prepared, before := h.snapshotCount > 0, h.before
	h.mu.Unlock()
	if !prepared || first.Position <= before {
		return first, nil
	}
	if first.Position != before+1 {
		return metastore.Change{}, smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	second, err := s.upstream.Next()
	if err != nil {
		return metastore.Change{}, err
	}
	if second.Position != before+2 {
		return metastore.Change{}, smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	select {
	case <-s.ctx.Done():
		return metastore.Change{}, s.ctx.Err()
	case <-h.ready:
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.closed || h.failure != nil || !h.acknowledged || h.published || h.generation != s.generation || h.incarnation != s.incarnation || len(h.events) != 2 || !preciseSame(first, h.events[0]) || !preciseSame(second, h.events[1]) {
		return metastore.Change{}, errors.Join(smb.ErrNotifyRescan, h.failure)
	}
	// Compare the actual complete delivered interval before exposing either record.
	if err := preciseInterval(h.snapshot, h.before, h.after, h.request, []metastore.Change{first, second}); err != nil {
		return metastore.Change{}, err
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if s.closed || len(s.registry) != 0 {
		return metastore.Change{}, smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	for _, event := range h.events {
		copy, err := preciseCopyChange(event)
		if err != nil {
			return metastore.Change{}, err
		}
		s.registry[event.Position] = &preciseProofRecord{event: copy, root: 1, incarnation: s.incarnation, generation: s.generation}
	}
	if err := h.saveEvidenceLocked(&h.evidence.DeliveredEvents, []metastore.Change{first, second}); err != nil {
		return metastore.Change{}, h.failLocked(err)
	}
	s.queued = []metastore.Change{second}
	h.snapshot = nil
	h.events = nil
	h.published = true
	return first, nil
}

func (s *preciseHistoryStream) RetainNotificationProof(event metastore.Change) (smb.DiagnosticNotificationProof, error) {
	h := s.owner
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if h.closed || s.closed || h.generation != s.generation || h.incarnation != s.incarnation {
		return nil, smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	record := s.registry[event.Position]
	if record == nil {
		if h.snapshotCount > 0 && event.Position > h.before {
			return nil, smb.ErrNotifyRescan
		}
		return nil, nil
	}
	if !preciseSame(event, record.event) || record.refs >= 8 {
		return nil, smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	record.refs++
	return &preciseProof{stream: s, record: record}, nil
}

func (proof *preciseProof) Validate(ctx context.Context, root uint64, position metastore.Position, filter uint32, recursive bool, events []wire.Notification) error {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s := proof.stream
	h := s.owner
	h.mu.Lock()
	s.mu.Lock()
	if h.closed || s.closed || proof.released || h.generation != s.generation || h.incarnation != s.incarnation || proof.record.generation != s.generation || proof.record.incarnation != s.incarnation || proof.record.root != root || proof.record.event.Position != position || filter != 31 || !recursive {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		h.mu.Unlock()
		return smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	s.pins++
	s.mu.Unlock()
	h.mu.Unlock()
	defer func() {
		s.mu.Lock()
		s.pins--
		if s.closed && s.pins == 0 {
			close(s.drained)
		}
		s.mu.Unlock()
	}()
	expected, err := smb.DiagnosticMapNotifications(proof.record.event, int64(root), filter, recursive)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !slices.Equal(expected, events) {
		return smb.ErrNotifyRescan
	}
	return ctx.Err()
}

func (proof *preciseProof) Release() {
	s := proof.stream
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if proof.released {
		panic("precise notification proof released twice")
	}
	proof.released = true
	proof.record.refs--
	if proof.record.refs < 0 {
		panic("negative precise notification ownership")
	}
}

func (s *preciseHistoryStream) Close() error {
	s.closeOnce.Do(func() {
		h := s.owner
		h.mu.Lock()
		s.mu.Lock()
		s.closed = true
		clear(s.registry)
		s.registry = nil
		clear(s.queued)
		s.queued = nil
		if s.pins == 0 {
			close(s.drained)
		}
		delete(h.streams, s)
		s.mu.Unlock()
		h.mu.Unlock()
		s.cancel()
		s.closeErr = s.upstream.Close()
		<-s.drained
	})
	return s.closeErr
}

func (h *preciseHistory) Close() error {
	h.authority.mu.Lock()
	h.mu.Lock()
	if h.authority.precise == h {
		h.authority.precise = nil
	}
	h.closed = true
	h.readyOnce.Do(func() { close(h.ready) })
	streams := make([]*preciseHistoryStream, 0, len(h.streams))
	for s := range h.streams {
		streams = append(streams, s)
	}
	h.snapshot = nil
	h.events = nil
	h.evidence = preciseHistoryPayload{}
	h.evidenceBytes = 0
	h.mu.Unlock()
	h.authority.mu.Unlock()
	var err error
	for _, s := range streams {
		err = errors.Join(err, s.Close())
	}
	return err
}

func (h *preciseHistory) saveEvidenceLocked(destination *json.RawMessage, value any) error {
	if len(*destination) != 0 {
		return errors.New("precise evidence cannot replace an earlier observation")
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(encoded) > preciseMaxEvidenceBytes-h.evidenceBytes {
		return syscall.EFBIG
	}
	h.evidenceBytes += len(encoded)
	*destination = encoded
	return nil
}

type preciseHistoryEvidence struct {
	Incarnation                                              metastore.Incarnation
	Generation                                               uint64
	SnapshotNodes                                            int
	Before, After                                            metastore.Position
	Action                                                   storage.FileActionID
	Session                                                  uint64
	Reference                                                storage.FileReferenceID
	Fingerprint, StoredFingerprint                           string
	Begun, Ended, Finalized, Acknowledged, Published, Closed bool
	SourceCount, EvidenceBytes                               int
	Payload                                                  preciseHistoryPayload
	Error                                                    string
}

func (h *preciseHistory) Evidence() preciseHistoryEvidence {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	payload := preciseHistoryPayload{
		Request:     bytes.Clone(h.evidence.Request),
		PreSnapshot: bytes.Clone(h.evidence.PreSnapshot), CapturedEvents: bytes.Clone(h.evidence.CapturedEvents),
		StoredReceipt: bytes.Clone(h.evidence.StoredReceipt), Acknowledgment: bytes.Clone(h.evidence.Acknowledgment), DeliveredEvents: bytes.Clone(h.evidence.DeliveredEvents),
	}
	result := preciseHistoryEvidence{Incarnation: h.incarnation, Generation: h.generation, SnapshotNodes: h.snapshotCount, Before: h.before, After: h.after, Action: h.action, Session: h.session, Reference: h.reference, Fingerprint: fmt.Sprintf("%x", h.fingerprint), StoredFingerprint: fmt.Sprintf("%x", h.storedFingerprint), Begun: h.begun, Ended: h.ended, Finalized: h.finalized, Acknowledged: h.acknowledged, Published: h.published, Closed: h.closed, SourceCount: len(h.streams), EvidenceBytes: h.evidenceBytes, Payload: payload}
	if h.failure != nil {
		result.Error = h.failure.Error()
	}
	return result
}

// Keep a concrete check in the generated fixture: a source hook with a different
// lifetime or signature must fail compilation before any native invocation.
var _ smb.DiagnosticHistoryStream = (*preciseHistoryStream)(nil)
var _ smb.DiagnosticNotificationProof = (*preciseProof)(nil)
